description: Collaborative snag/punch-list/defect tracking: Next.js web + Expo mobile on Supabase

stack.web: Next.js 16 App Router + TS strict + Tailwind v4
stack.backend: Supabase (Postgres RLS, Auth, Storage, Realtime, Edge Functions)
stack.testing: Vitest (shared, DB, mobile units/services) + Playwright (web and isolated mobile browser preview)

testing.gate: pnpm turbo run build lint typecheck test

e2e.requires: real local Supabase + running web app + Chrome/Chromium

mobile.requires: Integration: local Supabase; browser: separate Expo preview and Chrome

current_state.phase: 5 mobile online implemented locally; hosted/physical-device acceptance pending
current_state.last_work: Native Expo auth, project/snags, camera/markup, assigned work/review and report sharing
current_state.next_recommended: Authorize hosted deployment and perform physical-device acceptance before Phase 6
blockers: Hosted project/access and device information not provided; hosted changes require explicit authorization
